name: MsoExtrusionColorType
description: Specifies whether the extrusion color is based on the extruded shape's fill (the front face of the extrusion) and automatically changes when the shape's fill changes, or whether the extrusion color is independent of the shape's fill. Used with the ExtrusionColorType property of the ThreeDFormat object.

constants.name: msoExtrusionColorTypeMixed
constants.description: Return value only; indicates a combination of the other states.

constants.name: msoExtrusionColorAutomatic
constants.description: Extrusion color is based on shape fill.

constants.name: msoExtrusionColorCustom
constants.description: Extrusion color is independent of shape fill.
